results.name: a move may empty its source
results.note: Equivalent mutant, not a harness hole. `army_to_move` guards its invariant twice over — once in the `raw` formula and again in the clamp — so either alone is sufficient and deleting either is unobservable. The Python is written the same way; the redundancy is being ported faithfully, not introduced here.

results.name: neutral flag survives a loss
results.note: Unobservable by construction: `ownership_neutral` and `ownership[seat]` are disjoint on every well-formed state, so the mask it clears is always empty. Faithful to the Python, and only a malformed state could tell the difference.
